description: Java class 'ParameterListTableModel' extending AbstractTableModel, managing a table model for parameter list with logger data, including methods for adding, selecting, clearing parameters, and interacting with a DataRegistrationBroker.

classes.name: ParameterListTableModel
classes.description: A table model for managing logger parameter data in a GUI table, supporting selection, addition, and clearing of parameters, and interaction with a data registration broker.

methods.name: ParameterListTableModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table model with a data registration broker and data type.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows (parameters) in the table.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a specified column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable based on its column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific row and column.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets the value at a specific row and column, updating selection state.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in a column.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a new logger data parameter to the table, with selection state.

methods.name: selectParam
methods.description: Selects or deselects a logger data parameter.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all parameters and unregisters them from the broker.

methods.name: getParameterRows
methods.description: Returns a list of all parameter rows.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selected state of a parameter row and registers/deregisters it with the broker.
